description.value: Judge Begbies Tavern is a lively neighborhood sports bar and live-entertainment venue anchored on historic Columbia Street in New Westminster's downtown core. It screens major league sports including Canucks, Whitecaps, and NFL games, and hosts weekly open mic nights and karaoke, drawing a regular local crowd. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available in a non-smoking setting.
